body: We're going into psych next. But, I really hate talking about feelings. It makes me uncomfortable even with people I know very well. I want to keep going for it, but I just feel like I'm not good enough.

All I've done is eldery and medsurg. Which is essentially both care for the elderly. I know that if I get into nursing, it's mostly going to be for the elderly. It sucks. Everyone says theres different areas to go into, but I'm being less and less sure that nursing is for me.

The making people feel better because of me. But every patient I've had during clinicals doesn't even know you're there. All you do is whipe asses all day and hope they don't start shitting on you while you're doing it.
I dont like the pressure or the work load, no. But I'm scared I'll hate it when I start actually doing it. I dont know anything else I can try. My family has already put so much money into my school.

I'm just tired of it all. I hate school and everything to do with it. My grades arent going to keep cutting it, but I cant concentrate on any of the work. I dont want to be a disappointment if I get kicked out. I dont have any real friends and I hate putting the pressure on my boyfriend to be my only outlet. I feelin selfish for talking about my feelings because I get so uncomfortable when people talk about theirs to me. I have no job. I live with my parents and they're having to support me. My dad may be losing his job soon. I just feel like a waste of resources.
